# Resham Chikankari

> Authentic, GI-Certified Hand-Embroidered Lucknowi Chikankari Kurtis, Suits, and Ethnic Apparel Handcrafted by Master Women Artisans in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## About the Brand
Resham Chikankari (https://www.reshamchikankari.com) is a premier Indian ethnic wear label dedicated to reviving and honoring the 400-year-old royal art of Lucknowi Chikankari. Born from a shared family heritage in Hazratganj, Lucknow, the brand directly sustains over 100 skilled women artisans across Awadh villages.

## Core Craftsmanship & Techniques
Every garment is individually traced, hand-stitched, washed, and finished in Lucknow using traditional Awadhi needlecraft:
- **Bakhiya (Shadow Work)**: Herringbone stitch on the wrong side creating an opaque, cloudy shadow motif on the right side.
- **Phanda**: Intricate raised millet or pearl knot stitches used for flower buds and center pistils.
- **Murri**: Ultra-fine elongated rice-grain stitches requiring immense dexterity.
- **Keel Kangan**: Delicate raised stitches resembling slender bangles and floral petals.
- **Tepchi**: Linear running stitch outlining paisley and jaal patterns.
- **Jaali (Trellis Work)**: Thread-parting lace-like apertures created without cutting any cloth threads.
- **Mukaish (Kamdani / Badla)**: Genuine silver and gold metallic ribbon wires flattened into the fabric to form dazzling sunbursts and sequins.

## Fabrics Used
- Pure Chanderi Silk
- Breathable Mulmul Cotton & Pure Muslin
- Luster Modal & Viscose Rayon
- Pure Georgette & Organza

## Product Collections
- **Kurtis & Kurtas** (https://www.reshamchikankari.com/shop/kurtis-kurtas): Everyday breathable cotton and festive georgette kurtis.
- **Kurtas & Co-ord Sets** (https://www.reshamchikankari.com/shop/coord-sets): Contemporary 2-piece and 3-piece sets with matching trousers.
- **Bottom Wear** (https://www.reshamchikankari.com/shop/bottom-wear): Hand-embroidered straight pants, shararas, and flared palazzos.
- **Premium Heirloom Collection** (https://www.reshamchikankari.com/shop/premium): Masterpiece handcrafted ensembles (> ₹4,000) with dense shadow-work and fine Mukaish embellishments.
